text: A loose shelf in a cupboard tipped forward when the cupboard was opened, causing three folders to fall. No items were damaged and no injuries were reported. The remaining folders were removed from the cupboard and placed on a table to prevent further movement or potential damage. A note was left to alert others not to use the cupboard until the loose shelf can be inspected, secured, or repaired.
